instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Precision metal fabrication shop specializing in CNC-machined aluminum and titanium components for aerospace and automotive Tier-1 suppliers. We run 12 CNC machining centers across two shifts. Currently implementing ISO 9001:2025 certification and evaluating robotic tending automation. We are a bootstrapped company with a lean team. Every euro of investment must show near-immediate ROI given our constrained working capital. The founder is involved in all strategic decisions including innovation priorities.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time to recurring revenue, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion. We need to identify the highest-leverage growth levers without overextending our cash runway.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

input.changes_since_last: Completed 2 strategic partnerships. Revenue growth 10% YoY. Exploring AI/ML capabilities.

opportunities.title: Systematize and Scale Digital Customer Onboarding (Recurring Revenue Focus)
opportunities.rationale: The recent success with the digital onboarding flow provides a powerful, quantifiable engine for growth. To achieve €50M ARR, this process must be formalized into an enterprise sales motion that generates predictable, recurring revenue, rather than remaining merely a customer service improvement.

first_actions: Define 3-tiered subscription/service bundles based on current product usage (Tier 1: Basic Maintenance; Tier 2: Advanced ML Integration; Tier 3: Full Service Contract).
Integrate the digital onboarding flow with a CRM to track renewal dates, service level agreements (SLAs), and upsell opportunities.
Develop standardized internal training materials for sales/customer success on selling recurring value streams.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase percentage of revenue derived from subscription/recurring services by 15% within 12 months.
milestones: Pilot recurring model with 3 existing high-value clients.
Launch tiered product documentation and pricing architecture.
Achieve measurable uptake of recurring services in the new onboarding flow.

opportunities.title: Build Scalable Technical Backbone and Productization Framework
opportunities.rationale: The current model, heavily reliant on the founder's hands-on technical input, is an inherent bottleneck for massive growth (scaling to €50M). A radical shift is needed to productize proprietary knowledge and transition technical work from founder/contractor dependence to a formal, empowered engineering function.

first_actions: Hire or contract a fractional CTO/Engineering Lead to define the 18-month tech roadmap and core architecture standards.
Implement structured internal documentation (Runbooks) for all CNC processes, ML integrations, and operational procedures to de-risk reliance on single individuals.
Establish an 'Innovation Sandbox' budget to test new technologies (e.g., advanced AI/ML predictive maintenance models) without disrupting core operations.
resources_needed: Increased operational CAPEX for testing hardware
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce founder involvement (hours per week dedicated to hands-on coding/design) by 30% within one year.
milestones: Formalization of the core product architecture and technology stack.
Hiring and onboarding of a technical team lead.
Successful deployment of first non-founder-dependent process automation.

next_steps.action: Conduct a formal job analysis to define the roles and responsibilities for the newly required Engineering Lead/CTO, shifting focus from 'doing' to 'designing process'.
Formalize the Sales Playbook for recurring revenue, mapping current customer pain points to defined subscription service bundles (Tier 1, 2, 3).
Develop a prioritized list of compliance requirements stemming from ISO 9001:2025 implementation that directly impact the digital customer onboarding workflow.

key_weaknesses: Extreme founder dependency acts as a critical bottleneck to scaling and formalized growth.
Lack of defined technical organizational structure prevents the systematic development of advanced AI/ML capabilities.
While strategic goals are ambitious (€50M ARR), the pricing model remains overly reliant on one-time project revenue, limiting predictable cash flow.

improvements: Successfully completed a cross-functional digital customer onboarding flow, significantly improving initial customer experience (12 days -> 5 days).
Established positive proof points for market expansion via two strategic partnerships and demonstrated 10% YoY revenue growth.
Initiated the implementation of robust quality standards through ISO 9001:2025 certification efforts.
persistent_gaps: The organizational structure (Talent/Process) has not kept pace with strategic ambition.
Technical knowledge transfer and process documentation remain critical bottlenecks.
Limited bandwidth forces the founder to handle core technical strategy alongside daily operations.
achieved_milestones: Digital customer onboarding flow implemented and piloted.
Initial progress made on ISO 9001:2025 certification readiness.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company moved from identifying potential opportunities to actively executing and quantifying results (e.g., onboarding flow efficiency). Growth proof points are established, but the structural barriers preventing massive scale remain in place.
